scorecard.rationale: One randomized trial in forensic inpatients reports lower state anxiety over time with Atlantic salmon versus meat control (PMID25431880, p=.043; trait anxiety inconclusive; grilling and boiling pooled). Competing trials show null anxiety after angina fish advice with optional fish oil (+0.82, 95% CI -0.57 to 2.22) and null SDQ emotional symptoms in FINS-TEENS mixed oily-fish lunches (high-baseline subgroup favored meat), while Parkinson cohorts (MVP-2024, Fox Insight, Lithuanian MedDiet) pool fish or whole diets without species or poaching estimates. The non-Parkinson salmon trial sustains a minimal_signal easing lean. The chum salmon pituitary isolation report and its receptor review are a related mechanism trail. They do not test edible Atlantic salmon flesh or observed anxiety in a culinary comparison. The minimal sign rests on the existing human food trial, with distance from poaching and Parkinson disease. The astaxanthin review lists salmon among sources of the isolated substance. Its distinct experiments do not supply a poached-salmon anxiety comparison. The earlier human food trial remains the main signal.
